from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared_memory = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MAZE_SHARED_MEMORY_WORKER] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MAZE_SHARED_MEMORY_AGGREGATOR,
        )
        memory_seed = await shared_memory(problem)
        seed_text = (memory_seed or {}).get("response") or "not exist the path from start to end."

        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MAZE_STAR_WORKER_V1] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MAZE_STAR_AGGREGATOR_V1,
        )
        solution = await star(f"{problem}\n\nShared verification summary:\n{seed_text}")
        final_response = (solution or {}).get("response") or "not exist the path from start to end."
        return f"```text\n{final_response}\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
